title: Send a resource from a comment
summary: Someone comments your keyword on a selected post and receives the resource link in Instagram DM.
body:
# Send a Resource From a Comment

## What The Owner Supplies

Use the connected Instagram account and one selected post. Ask for the resource title and its working public HTTPS link only if missing. Suggest one keyword in the owner's language. Draft the two messages. Do not ask for technical IDs.

## Subscriber Path

1. The subscriber comments the approved keyword on the selected post.
2. The public reply says: "Check your DMs and message requests."
3. The private message says: "Here is {resource_title}: {resource_url}".
4. The subscriber opens the resource. This campaign ends after delivery.

Use the owner's approved wording and language. The resource link belongs in the first DM. No confirmation question, contact form, reminder or subsequent AI reply is part of this funnel. Do not add a YES/NO branch.

## Configuration

Follow account operations. On the owned paused comment custom, set explicit selected post IDs and the approved keyword with exact matching. Set the public and private replies to ExactText. Set incomingMessages.howToReply to DontReply and followUps.howToSend to DontSend on that custom. Preserve the shared DM base and Main. Verify each saved value and all enabled flags before asking to activate.

## Checks

The approved keyword under the selected post delivers the exact DM. The same word under a different post and a different word under this post do not match this campaign. Silence and a link click do not start a follow-up. Test duplicate comments and refusals; do not promise behavior that was not observed. Check that the resource opens for the recipient without the owner's login. A missing or restricted resource prevents activation.

After an approved text edit, verify the next authorized test gets the new copy. After stopping, verify this rule is OFF and a new authorized entry receives nothing from it. Check unrelated support and another campaign remain unchanged.
